scope: Independent pre-freeze code review and read-only post-freeze packet/source/cost/scoring audit. No inference or retrieval re-execution.

pre_freeze_findings.finding: Impact reservation removed only one excess request
Four-new-read cap not enforced for short seed
Uncapped seed versus capped final evidence
Mandatory budget/no normative evidence review eligibility
Alternative valid evidence misclassified as unnecessary
S1 regrouping cost dropped seed evidence
Inherited runtime dependencies/package versions not enforced by seal

parent_reported_relevant_suite.provenance: Reported by parent, not rerun by independent reviewer.

manual_samples.finding: Name+ZIP declaration and actual parameter context present.
Original USER diagnostic result retains USER actor.

reference_audit.limitation: Offset/hash and manual source relevance checks do not certify exhaustive reference sets or truth of observations.

post_freeze_offline_audit.scorer_method: Independent interval-merging implementation over original document offsets; author covered/score_reference/retrieve not called. Category, alternatives, irrelevance and aggregate checks repeated on saved packets.
post_freeze_offline_audit.selection_audit: Inspected saved development-only frozen selection. No ranking/adaptor rerun or tuning.

protected_paths.gitattributes_note: Changed solely for research artifact line-ending rules; not production behavior.

reviewer_actions.note: Library upstream read-only browsing was recorded separately in library_audit.json.

interpretation_limits: Reference recall is not semantic sufficiency or binary F1.
A retains different original read units, unsupported formats and token-budget failures.
Recorded raw payload/graph adjacency is not ownership, authority, success or current-world proof.
Known valid.parquet diagnostics are not an independent hidden holdout.
Official S2G not executed; API-inspired diagnostic remains separately named.
